matches.rationale: No finding addresses the omission of the normalization term in Theorem 3.3; pred_id 1 describes an erroneous extra term rather than its absence.

Both identify the unfair experimental protocol where competing methods (OLS, Zipf-LS) were not given equivalent hyperparameter tuning under the altered training recipe, challenging the fairness of reported improvements.

The ground truth flags data integrity issues with Logit Penalty's unusually large values in Table 2; pred_id 6 points out a text–table inconsistency about the direction of change, which is a different issue.
No finding addresses the oversimplified causal claim in the Introduction regarding error amplification and representation collapse.
The ground truth concerns omission of low-shot zero-accuracy analysis in Section 4.1.6; pred_id 10 discusses a contradictory Impact statement, a different location and issue.
No finding identifies the implausible standard deviation values in Tables 4/5.
No finding addresses the incorrect gradient derivation in Section 3.2 that neglects the mean-logit dependency.
No finding targets the over-generalized elimination/transfer claims in the Conclusion.
No finding detects the fabricated reference [11] in the CIFAR-10-C experimental description.
No finding reports the internal contradiction about disabling CutMix and Mixup for DeiT-Small versus later appendices showing them enabled.
No finding discusses the promotional, unqualified phrasing in the abstract.
